answer: Every identity posts a jade escrow bond at registration, and before a receipt reaches the ledger two unrelated peers rerun the same job from a clean snapshot and compare output hashes. A farm holding an oasis of 1,000 fake agents must lock 1,000 bonds and buy 2,000 duplicate executions, so faking each opal costs exactly the compute it was meant to earn: 5,000 POA locked per identity against 40 POA of reward.
